subject: [Invite] AI Execs Dinner in Zurich Altstadt - 2nd July
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We're hosting an intimate private dinner for AI & Computer Vision Leaders in Zurich's Altstadt on Wednesday 2nd July and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available. 

It'll be an informal, open-format evening - no slides or pitches, just bringing together like-minded people to discuss their experiences & challenges building AI companies. The venue will be a private room in one of the Old Town's top spots - with details to be finalised by the end of next week. 

Attendance is reserved for senior leaders (Co-founders / CTOs / Heads of AI / Product etc.) from existing Encord partners and other leading AI/ML scale-ups and organisations - with confirmed attendees including leaders from Sportradar, ABB, and Synthesia. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform built to help AI teams bring better models to market, faster. We work with over 200 teams including Woven-Toyota, Pickle Robot, & Carbon Robotics, and have offices in SF & London. 

Would you be interested in joining? Let me know and I can ask the team to send over details once confirmed,

subject: Dinner on 06/14 for AI leaders at CVPR?
text:

If you're in Nashville for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a
small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent-ex-VP of AI at Meta,
Chief R&D Officer at Nexar- followed by dinner for AI leaders in Nashville
this Saturday - we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can make
it!

We've booked a private dining room at Moto Nashville, capping attendance at
~25 people and it's strictly reserved for senior leaders (CTOs, Heads of
ML, Co-founders) from our existing Encord partners and/or other leading
AI/ML scale-ups and orgs - confirmed are Safely You and Verkada from the
video surveillance space.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all is well - wondering if you or anyone from the Korro team is
heading over to CVPR this year? Sharing details of an event we're hosting,
if you'll be there.

Our Head of AI is hosting an exclusive fireside chat for AI leaders during
CVPR with Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, Chief R&D officer at
Nexar), followed by an intimate roundtable dinner - & we'd love for you to
join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Moto Cucina - about
a 15 min walk from the conference - on Saturday 14th June, starting at 6:30
PM. Attendees are strictly reserved for senior leaders (Co-founders / CTOs
/ Heads of AI etc.) from existing Encord partners and other leading AI/ML
scale-ups and organisations - with confirmed attendees including leaders
from Captions, Woven-by-Toyota, and Pickle Robot.

Will you be at the conference / interested in joining?
